title.value: Compare grocery prices across stores from a list

introduction.value: A tech worker built a Gemini browser agent that takes a typed or scanned handwritten grocery list and compares prices on Amazon Fresh and Flipkart Minutes.

method.value: Vikas Ranjan built an assistant called Dinu Kaka with the browser-use library (Playwright), driven by Gemini 2.0 Flash in his own Chrome. You type a list or upload a handwritten one, and the agent searches each item on Amazon Fresh and Flipkart Minutes. It screenshots prices, discounts and delivery details, picks the best option, adds it to the cart and writes a summary report.

outcome.value: The author says it freed up his weekends and gets him good deals without hours of research. The article gives no timings, savings figures or accuracy results, and a reader asked how long a 15–20 item list takes.

notes.value: The published code is simplified, and its task prompt doesn't show how the list is passed in. Check the linked GitHub repo for the real setup.

source_text.body:
Compare grocery prices across stores from a list
A tech worker built a Gemini browser agent that takes a typed or scanned handwritten grocery list and compares prices on Amazon Fresh and Flipkart Minutes.
Done with
GE
Gemini
What they did
Vikas Ranjan built an assistant called Dinu Kaka with the browser-use library (Playwright), driven by Gemini 2.0 Flash in his own Chrome. You type a list or upload a handwritten one, and the agent searches each item on Amazon Fresh and Flipkart Minutes. It screenshots prices, discounts and delivery details, picks the best option, adds it to the cart and writes a summary report.
How it went
The author says it freed up his weekends and gets him good deals without hours of research. The article gives no timings, savings figures or accuracy results, and a reader asked how long a 15–20 item list takes.
Worth knowing
The published code is simplified, and its task prompt doesn't show how the list is passed in. Check the linked GitHub repo for the real setup.
Try it yourself
with
Gemini
Copy prompt
Here is my grocery list: [paste list or attach a photo of a handwritten list]. Compare prices for each item across [store 1] and [store 2], noting pack sizes and anything out of stock. Give me a table with the cheapest option per item and the total per store. Do not add anything to a cart or place an order without showing me first.
Original source: https://medium.com/google-cloud/effortless-grocery-shopping-creating-an-ai-agent-with-gemini-to-automate-your-purchases-a1c51973633b
